<title level="1" right="Spell 8" pfs="Standard">
[Hidden Mind](/Spells.aspx?ID=1556)
<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 335

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 30 feet

**Target** 1 creature
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** until your next daily preparations
</row>

</column>

---

Powerful wards hide a creature from magic that would spy on it or affect its mind. The target gains a +4 status bonus to saves against [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106) effects. Hidden mind attempts to [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) any [detection](/Traits.aspx?ID=43), [revelation](/Traits.aspx?ID=138), and [scrying](/Traits.aspx?ID=141) effects as if its spell rank were 1 higher than its actual rank. On a success, the effect functions normally except that it detects nothing about the target and its possessions. For instance, [_detect magic_](/Spells.aspx?ID=66) would still detect other magic in the area, but not any magic on the target.
name: Hidden Mind
